decision.reason: Functional desktop suites pass, but real Worker sample continuity repeatedly breaks under loaded Atlas and on the 390 px real run. Controlled full-load and mobile suites pass; real minimal passes. Same full Chromium with explicit SwiftShader reproduces severe delays. No product or threshold changes are justified by this evidence.
decision.unblockingCondition: Repeat the required real MediaPipe campaign on a runtime that preserves the unchanged sampling/watchdog contract under the measured Atlas loads; do not relax the product thresholds.

verifyAnatomy.reason: Anatomy unchanged; previous accepted campaign not repeated

limitations: Synthetic photographs are composited into a live canvas video. They are not a physical webcam assessment.
All failures are preserved. A successful campaign does not guarantee scheduling deadlines on every machine or every run.
GC was not separately measured. Worker detectForVideo timings are wall-clock durations, not CPU-only profiling.
The readback contrast deliberately takes screenshots inside tracking; functional captures are outside measured gestures.
DPR settings below 1 do not lower the production Canvas below its existing minimum of 1.
